description: SerMon dependency updates – requires the Renovate GitHub App on the repository.

packageRules.description: install-action must know the tool versions it installs, otherwise it falls back to cargo-binstall (ADR 0006) – update them together.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Check the CI annotations: no `fallback to cargo-binstall` warning may appear.

packageRules.description: These projects tag releases with a v prefix; we pin the plain version.
Generated code depends on these versions – regenerate and commit with `just gen`.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Run `just gen` and commit the regenerated code; CI (`just check-gen`) fails otherwise.
⚠️ Update `BETTERLEAKS_SHA256` in `.github/workflows/security.yml` from the release's `checksums.txt` – the secret scan fails on a checksum mismatch.

⚠️ Update `COSIGN_SHA256`, `SYFT_SHA256` or `SLSA_VERIFIER_SHA256` in `.github/workflows/release.yml` from the release's checksums – the release fails on a mismatch. A new cosign: also `COSIGN_IMAGE` in `deploy/compose/use-release.sh` and the commands in `docs/admin/installation.md`.

customManagers.description: Tool versions annotated with `# renovate: datasource=… depName=…` (workflow env blocks and the devcontainer setup script).
Rust protoc plugins installed by `just install-proto-plugins`.

Images pinned by digest outside compose files and Dockerfiles (M2-39): nfpm and the test hosts in scripts/, the base images of the E2E agent hosts (build args), BuildKit of the release and cosign of use-release.sh (V1-03, V1-04).
